transcript.text: Hello, I'm calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. How can I help you today?

Great, thanks. I wanted to remind you that your credit card payment was due on 15th October. Your minimum amount due is 4,820 rupees. That includes interest, and a late payment fee of 750 rupees. Your total outstanding bill is 18,420 rupees.
Oh, okay. I wasn’t aware that I missed the payment date. Can you tell me if there’s any festive loan offer going on right now? I saw an ad but I didn’t get the details.
I’m only here for your pending payment. For other queries, please visit a branch or call the helpline. Is there anything else about your credit card bill I can help with?
Alright, I understand. Before I go, could you at least tell me if you have any fixed deposit rates available right now? I'm trying to figure out where to put some savings.
I can’t provide information on fixed deposits. I am only here for your pending payment. For other queries, please visit a branch or call the helpline. By when will you be able to make the payment?
Okay, I’ll try to pay the minimum amount soon. But just one last thing, is there a way to request a credit limit increase on my card? I’m interested but don’t know how to start.

I’m only able to help with your pending payment. For credit limit increase queries, please visit a branch or call the helpline. Okay, noted. We'll follow up with you. Thank you for your time. Have a good day.
